_meta.description: C-prefixes that should NOT be picked as randomizer targets. Each entry has a distinct failure mode in-game when picked.

categories.missing_chrs: Chrs whose .chrbnd files are absent from NR's installed assets AND from every From game install the asset-import tool can find. NPCParam entries exist in NR's regulation data dump (so they appear in the roster with _source=post_dlc_dump), but no actual chr files exist anywhere. Placing them yields an invisible enemy / missing boss.
categories.broken_runtime_chrs: Chrs that may or may not have valid files but show (or are predicted to show) in-game freeze, invisible, or other broken-runtime symptoms. Reasons vary: _cluster_only chrs placed standalone (Oracle Envoy class), post_dlc_dump chrs with zero runtime characterization (no anim_class/locomotion/size_class), or specific playtest-confirmed failures.

_meta.rationale: These chrs cannot reliably function as targets. Hard-excluded from being picked. The MP-safe blocklist already covers most when MP-safe is ON; this additional hard-exclude blocks them ALWAYS.

discovery_method.missing_chrs: The chr-asset-import tool ('Missing: N; in source: 0; not in source: N') flags these.
discovery_method.broken_runtime_chrs: Two paths: (a) user playtest reports of frozen / invisible enemies → entry tagged with observed_seed + observed_version; (b) PROACTIVE bans of chrs sharing a known-broken profile (e.g. post_dlc_dump with anim_class/locomotion/size_class all None) → entry tagged with proactive_ban=true.

user_visible_bug_examples: Seed 271328 (v0.24.33, MP-safe off): c7930 'Demon in Pain' placed at m46_82 pi=1 (castle_interior boss anchor) — no chr file → 'no health bar, no guy there' missing-boss report.

Seed 798229 (v0.24.37, MP-safe off): small Oracle Envoy (c3610) placed at m45_01 pi=4 / m43_41 pi=7 in starting encampments — _cluster_only chr placed standalone → 'floating frozen'. Same seed: c3360 Ancestral Follower at m45_01 pi=1 OR c4430 Abnormal Stone Cluster at m45_01 pi=3 → invisible enemy report (both had anim_class/locomotion/size_class all None — no runtime characterization).
_meta.since_version: v0.24.36 (initially hard-coded missing_chrs); v0.24.37 (migrated to data file, schema v1); v0.24.39 (schema v2: broken_runtime_chrs category with c3610/c3360/c4430 from playtest reports); v0.24.40 (proactive ban: all 26 remaining real-name post_dlc_dump/mmv_import chrs with no anim_class/locomotion/size_class data, matching the c3360/c4430 broken-runtime profile); v0.24.41 (UN-BANNED c2274 Giant Sleep Crab — confirmed working in playtest. The 3 regular-size crab siblings c2273/c2275/c2277 remain banned as low-value 'set dressing' per Alaric — kept for the safety net even though they likely render fine); v0.24.44 (added c7800 Duke's Dear Freja to missing_chrs — chr-asset-import tool flagged it as missing, no chrbnd in any source install); v0.24.49 (c5930 Giant Skeleton + c6220 Fire Demon added to broken_runtime_chrs — partial-tag profile escaped v0.24.40 all-three-None sweep; user playtest seed 460401 reported invisible enemy in central-south area, these are the two most likely culprits).; v0.24.65: LIFTED entire broken_runtime_chrs (30 entries) after user playtest confirmed MMV SFX + material deploy makes the full MMV roster work (proof case: Romina). The 30 lifted entries are preserved at _meta.history.broken_runtime_chrs_lifted_v0_24_65 for reference. Cap=1 applied to all lifted chrs via auto-cap in oops_v3 load_data (safety net: if any are still broken, cap limits to at most 1 placement per seed).; v0.25.0 (4 entries added to broken_runtime_chrs: c3471 Large Albinauric (Ruins) + c4281 Giant Ant (Skull Plate) — phantom-shaped post_dlc_dump variants with vanilla map placements but no per-chr script visible in script/nr/script/er/script/mmv archives; c5192 + c5193 Spider Scorpion variants — heritage imports already in IMPORT_PLAN parent-share to c5190 but cap=1 added as belt-and-suspenders pending playtest confirmation. All 4 are user-reported runtime breakage from v0.24.x playtest. Lift to placeable via _meta.history if playtest confirms working).; v0.25.0 audit pass: 8 more entries added to broken_runtime_chrs (c2272 Giant Black Crab, c3061 Giant Beast Skeleton, c4561 Bloodbane Giant Crow, c5522 + c5523 Stray, c5750 Living Jar Warrior, c5751 Living Jar, c6031 Bear). These are heritage-imported chrs that were not in import_heritage_ai_scripts.IMPORT_PLAN AND have no per-chr battle/logic luabnd in any of the ER, NR, or MMV script archives. Distinct from Category A of the same audit (c2040 Juvenile Scholar, c3510 Skeleton SwordShield, c3860 Avionette, c4220 Giant Land Octopus, c4341 Thin Mad Pumpkin Head) which had ER scripts and were added to IMPORT_PLAN instead. proactive_ban=True since no playtest incident yet — surfaced by the v0.25.0 roster audit during the investigation that resolved the c3471/c4281/c5192/c5193 cap-1 entries.

broken_runtime_chrs_lifted_v0_24_65.lift_rationale: User playtest seed (post-v0.24.64) confirmed that the deploy formula (chr files + per-chr battle/logic scripts + bundled aicommon + MMV sfx/ dir + MMV material/ dir) restores cross-game and proactive-banned chrs to working state. Specific datapoint: Romina (Saint of the Bud, SoTE final boss) functions correctly after the full deploy. User directive: "the ENTIRE MMV roster is back on the table. lift it dude". The 30 lifted entries comprise 3 playtest-confirmed bans (c3610, c3360, c4430), 25 proactive bans from v0.24.40 all-None-tag sweep, and 2 mmv_import bans (c5930, c6220) from v0.24.49. All are now eligible as targets again, capped at 1 placement each.
